summary: Answered the last reachability limit of the constructor question: the stall occurs with MaxAppendEntries at its default 64. The live harness now leaves the batch size at the default and lets the follower accumulate a gap beyond 128×64 entries — its snapshot stays where the harness took it because the cluster is configured with a ten-minute SnapshotInterval and takes no automatic snapshot, which models delayed snapshotting — and the fixture reports the expected batch count alongside the observed channel capacity. Local construction feedback on the identical scenario: 8303 entries to replay, 130 batches against a 128-slot channel, the feature-on restart never returning within the window, the other two voters keeping a quorum, and the same stores restarted without the feature constructing normally with lastApplied still at the snapshot index and the control reporting the observed capacity of 128. The experiment is filed as a revision of the same question's previous live reproduction, with the default batch size, the larger gap and the batch-demand operand as its only semantic changes, and the admission asserting only schedule-independent facts (mode, cluster ids, leader, default batch size, gap flag) plus five comparisons covering the stalled restart, the control restart, the control's applied index, the batch demand exceeding the observed capacity, and the surviving quorum. Incomplete: that receipt and its interpretation, plus the unexercised user Restore and term-changing truncation repair paths.
